definition: a person who takes another's place
description: An amateur football match under floodlights at dusk. On the muddy touchline a fresh player in a clean blue kit slaps hands with a tired teammate whose blue kit is covered in mud, then jogs past him onto the pitch. The muddy player walks slowly off the pitch, breathing hard. Beside the dugout players in orange training bibs and a young woman in a black jacket clap. White lines cross the worn grass, and autumn trees and a red brick building stand behind under a deep blue sky.

en.question: What is the muddy player doing?

es.answer: Está saliendo del campo arrastrando los pies.

llevar una equipación manchada de barro
